headline: The magnet now swallows a chain
lede: PINBALL's pack magnet grew a mouth: while the coil holds a ball, a queued ball that touches the pack's outer face is dragged onto a rosette around the post — own clock, own payout. Cross-fire still bounces; the #3217/#3422 laws stand exactly as pinned.

notes.text: Chain-pin (#3452, PR #3458): 3 fed balls = 3 grabs, 3 clocks, 3 payouts; the rosette relaxes clockwise so a pack never overlaps. EMBER RIDER mirrors and pays its hotter 75.
pinballcheck 326/326 with 11 new chain pins and 21/21 mutants (chaincone + chainslot both die); pinballplay 68/68 on real Chrome with quiet-table gates added to the announce legs.

Both never-dry targets this session belonged to live slot b (#3443 smart bomb, #3445 respawn bug) — b shipped the bomb mid-shift. PINBALL was the honest weakest title by idle-kick; its oldest gap self-defers awaiting #3335, so the buildable residue went in instead.
A live coil bends fast shots into the post's field — the new lateral-refusal pin measures the pull-free window, and prod polls against jalfern.com need curl -L (the URL answers a redirect body).
